import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants (typos)
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric, removing commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (3650000 is likely 3650 with extra zeros)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
